original.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds a new ExternalArtifact kind (source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1) providing support for 3rd-party source controllers.

decision.reason: [ev-9ac7da44855f] only announces support for 3rd-party source controllers through ExternalArtifact. Validators confirmed from [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] that source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 ExternalArtifact first appears in this release and that the consequence is none. The only environments that touch this subject are those whose manifests use the new kind, so gvk-in-use on that group, version and kind is neither broader nor narrower than the subject. P3's alternative misuses cluster-version for Flux's own version and would flag every upgraded environment.
